Prealgebra · Lesson 11.9

Special Right Triangles

Solve this lesson →All lessons

Cut a square in half along its diagonal and you get a right triangle with two equal legs. Triangles like this show up everywhere, in ramps, rooftops, and folded napkins, so it pays to know them by heart. Start with the smallest one and measure its hypotenuse with the Pythagorean Theorem.

Problem
A right triangle has legs 11 and 11. Use the Pythagorean Theorem to find the square of the hypotenuse. What number is c2c2?
Show a hint
  • The theorem says a2+b2=c2a2+b2=c2, and here both legs are 11.
  • Compute 12+1212+12.
Show the full solution
The legs give c2=12+12=2c2=12+12=2, so the hypotenuse itself is 22​. The square of the hypotenuse is 22​.
Key idea
The 45-45-90 triangle. A right triangle with two equal legs also has two equal 4545 degree angles, so we call it a 45-45-90 triangle. If each leg is ss, the Pythagorean Theorem gives c2=s2+s2=2s2c2=s2+s2=2s2, so the hypotenuse is c=s2c=s2​. Multiplying by 22​ makes the hypotenuse about 1.411.41 times the leg. Every 45-45-90 triangle is half of a square, so the same ratio holds at every size.
Problem
Each leg of a 45-45-90 triangle is 55. The hypotenuse simplifies to k2k2​. What whole number is kk?
Show a hint
  • The hypotenuse of a 45-45-90 triangle is the leg times 22​.
  • With legs of 55, the hypotenuse is 5252​.
Show the full solution
Hypotenuse =s2=52=s2​=52​, so k=5k=5​. The theorem confirms it, since 52+52=5052+52=50 and 50=5250​=52​.
Problem
A wheelchair ramp rises at a 4545 degree angle, so its rise and its horizontal run are the two legs of a 45-45-90 triangle. The run is 1212 meters. How many meters is the rise?
Show a hint
  • In a 45-45-90 triangle the two legs are equal.
  • The rise and the run are the two legs.
Show the full solution
The legs of a 45-45-90 triangle are equal, so the rise matches the run at 1212​ meters.
Problem
The hypotenuse of a 45-45-90 triangle measures 7272​. How long is each leg?
Show a hint
  • Run the rule backwards. The hypotenuse is leg ×2×2​, so the leg is hypotenuse ÷2÷2​.
  • If s2=72s2​=72​, what is ss?
Show the full solution
The hypotenuse is always s2s2​. Matching s2=72s2​=72​ gives s=7s=7​.
Key idea
The 30-60-90 triangle. Cut an equilateral triangle straight down the middle and each half is a right triangle with angles of 3030, 6060, and 9090 degrees. Say the equilateral triangle has side 2x2x. The cut splits the base in half, so the short leg is xx, and the hypotenuse is an untouched side, 2x2x. The height comes from the Pythagorean Theorem, h2=(2x)2−x2=3x2h2=(2x)2−x2=3x2, so h=x3h=x3​. The sides always come in the ratio xx, x3x3​, 2x2x, where the short leg xx sits opposite the 3030 degree angle and the hypotenuse is exactly twice the short leg.
Problem
The short leg of a 30-60-90 triangle is 44. The hypotenuse is always twice the short leg. How long is the hypotenuse?
Show a hint
  • Hypotenuse =2×=2× short leg.
Show the full solution
Twice the short leg is 2×4=82×4=8​.
Problem
The hypotenuse of a 30-60-90 triangle is 1414. How long is the short leg?
Show a hint
  • The hypotenuse is twice the short leg, so run it backwards.
  • Half of 1414.
Show the full solution
The short leg is half the hypotenuse, 14÷2=714÷2=7​.
Problem
The short leg of a 30-60-90 triangle is 55. The long leg simplifies to k3k3​. What whole number is kk?
Show a hint
  • The long leg is the short leg times 33​.
  • With a short leg of 55, the long leg is 5353​.
Show the full solution
Long leg == short leg ×3=53×3​=53​. So k=5k=5​.
Fun fact
The clear plastic set squares in a geometry kit are exactly these two triangles, one 45-45-90 and one 30-60-90. Drafters picked them because their angles combine into 1515, 7575, 105105, and more, enough to draw nearly any standard angle.
Problem
An equilateral triangle has 1010 cm sides. Its height simplifies to k3k3​ cm. What whole number is kk?
Show a hint
  • The height cuts the triangle into two 30-60-90 halves, and the short leg of each half is half of 1010.
  • Height == short leg ×3×3​, and the short leg is 55.
Show the full solution
The height splits the base, so the short leg is 10÷2=510÷2=5, and the height is the long leg, 5353​. So k=5k=5​.
Key idea
The two special triangle ratios. A 45-45-90 triangle has sides ss, ss, s2s2​. A 30-60-90 triangle has sides xx, x3x3​, 2x2x, with the short leg opposite the smallest angle. Once you know the angles, you can write down the sides without any algebra. If you ever doubt a shortcut, check it with the Pythagorean Theorem.

Practice these ideas

Practice
Each leg of a 45-45-90 triangle is 33. The hypotenuse simplifies to k2k2​. What is kk?
Show the solution
Hypotenuse =32=32​, so k=3k=3​.
Practice
The hypotenuse of a 45-45-90 triangle is 112112​. How long is each leg?
Show the solution
From s2=112s2​=112​ we get s=11s=11​.
Practice
A square has 77 inch sides. Its diagonal simplifies to k2k2​ inches. What is kk?
Show the solution
The diagonal is side ×2=72×2​=72​, so k=7k=7​.
Practice
The short leg of a 30-60-90 triangle is 66. How long is the hypotenuse?
Show the solution
Hypotenuse =2×6=12=2×6=12​.
Practice
The hypotenuse of a 30-60-90 triangle is 2020. How long is the short leg?
Show the solution
Half of 2020 is 1010​.
Practice
The short leg of a 30-60-90 triangle is 88. The long leg simplifies to k3k3​. What is kk?
Show the solution
The long leg is 8383​, so k=8k=8​.
Practice
An equilateral triangle has 1212 cm sides. Its height simplifies to k3k3​ cm. What is kk?
Show the solution
The short leg is 12÷2=612÷2=6, so the height is 6363​ and k=6k=6​.
Practice
Each leg of a 45-45-90 triangle is 99. Use the Pythagorean Theorem to check the shortcut. What is the square of the hypotenuse?
Show the solution
c2=92+92=81+81=162c2=92+92=81+81=162​. The shortcut agrees, since (92)2=81×2=162(92​)2=81×2=162.
